text.text: Two kilometres west of Malé, Villimalé is the quiet suburb of the Greater Malé Region. Once a tourist resort, it became a residential island to relieve overcrowding in Malé. Today it is low-rise and close-knit, with tree-lined streets, quiet beaches and a slower pace of life.
Villimalé, an illustration by the Villimalé group.
Villimalé stays low-rise and green: a quiet place to live, beside the dense capital.

Villimalé is mainly a place to live, and a weekend escape, for people who work in Malé. Where Malé and Hulhumalé grow upward and dense, Villimalé stays low-rise and walkable, with the feel of a village.
